tasks.label: Env: seed archon_api.env (local only)
tasks.command: if (!(Test-Path policies/env)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory policies/env | Out-Null }; if (Test-Path policies/env/archon_api.env.example) { Copy-Item policies/env/archon_api.env.example policies/env/archon_api.env -Force } else { echo 'ARCHON_ENV=dev`nARCHON_PORT=7700' | Out-File -Encoding utf8 policies/env/archon_api.env }
